nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=45 beats='Miri arrives at quiet Willowbrook School with a corn bowl and fresh water for Poppy, Pepper, and Pip; only two hens hurry from the coop when she opens the yard gate'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=25 beats='Miri checks both nest boxes, finds the smallest hen missing, shuts Poppy and Pepper safely inside, and notices a loose latch, a pale feather, and tiny tracks'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Miri ties a blue ribbon to the loose latch and follows corn crumbs past the nesting ramp toward the feed room and hedge'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Miri follows three-toed prints past a red watering can; one trail reaches the caretaker shed, and muddy marks point toward the greenhouse'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Miri slips through the vegetable gate and finds a bent lettuce leaf, tiny prints, and dry leaves scattered toward the library courtyard'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='Near the coop, nibbled corn husks lead through the feed room door; beneath the ramp, fresh scratches continue beside the hedge and the covered feed cart; Miri listens for a cluck before choosing which trail to inspect'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='The caretaker shed door stands open beside a tipped flowerpot and two empty crates; farther on, muddy hen prints cross the path to the warm greenhouse, where a stack of pots hides a low seed shelf'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='The garden trail divides near the library courtyard; one set of prints ends beneath a bench packed with leaves, while another crosses the grass toward the sports pavilion, where the wind shakes a box of cloth bibs'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Inside the feed room, Miri finds a fallen scoop, empty seed sacks, and a narrow line of husks leading out toward the compost bays'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Miri kneels by the ramp; a feather lies inside the hedge tunnel, while the feed cart cloth moves above a round hollow in straw'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Sunlight reveals a feather beside the shed crates and fresh prints circling the fallen flowerpot before crossing toward the greenhouse walkway'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='In the greenhouse, Miri hears a pot scrape; muddy prints run beneath a heavy seed shelf and back toward the caretaker shed'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Miri finds a warm hollow beneath the library bench and a second trail of pale feathers winding into the nearby bean patch'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Beneath the pavilion steps, Miri spots muddy prints beside the sports box, but gusts are already covering the lightest marks with leaves'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=50 beats='Miri taps the corn bowl twice and hears one faint cluck; it could come from the dark space behind the empty sacks or from the warm compost leaves beyond the back door, where fresh husks lie in a crooked line'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=50 beats='Miri places corn between the two nearby hiding places; a branch trembles inside the hedge tunnel, then the loose cloth on the feed cart lifts and falls; she waits quietly and chooses where to look first'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=50 beats='At the covered walkway, Miri sees one trail curl around the fallen flowerpot and another disappear beneath the heavy greenhouse shelf; she can check the light objects herself or call caretaker Mr. Sol to move the heavy tray safely'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=50 beats='A soft rustle comes from beneath the leaf-filled library bench, but the bean patch also holds a tiny nest-shaped hollow and one fresh brown feather; Miri shakes the corn bowl and decides which quiet place to approach'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=50 beats='Miri hears a muffled cluck near the sports bib box as the wind sweeps away the last clear tracks; she can inspect the box now or fetch Mr. Sol to organize a wider search around the pavilion'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri crouches beside the empty seed sacks and taps her corn bowl; Pip pokes out her small brown head, shakes dust from her feathers, and walks into the light; Miri checks Pip gently, carries her back to Poppy and Pepper, fastens the loose coop latch, and records every clue in the holiday care book; she also draws a bright circle around the latch so Mr. Sol will know what needs fixing; Pip settles beside the other hens, safe and calm, while Miri replaces the fallen scoop and closes the feed room door; careful listening has solved the mystery before breakfast'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri follows the husks outside and parts the top layer of dry compost leaves; Pip sits in a warm hollow beside one small egg, looking proud of her secret nest; Miri offers corn, waits for Pip to stand, and settles her in a safe basket; back at the coop, Poppy and Pepper greet the missing hen with busy clucks; Mr. Sol repairs the loose latch while Miri places the egg in a padded box and writes where she found it; they cover the compost bay so the hens cannot wander inside again; the holiday morning ends with three hens home and one surprising treasure for the school nature table'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri sits beside the hedge without reaching into the prickly branches; she lays a short line of corn from the tunnel to the open yard and waits; Pip pecks one grain, then another, until her whole brown body appears; Miri guides her toward the coop with the bowl and lets her join Poppy and Pepper; she secures the loose latch with string until Mr. Sol can repair it; the blue ribbon on the gate reminds everyone to check the catch twice; Miri leaves a shallow dish of water near the hedge for garden birds, then records how patience brought Pip safely home; the three hens settle together in a sunny patch'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri lifts the feed cart cloth slowly and discovers Pip resting in a round straw hollow on the lower shelf; the little hen blinks, gives one cheerful cluck, and steps toward the corn bowl; Miri carries Pip back across the yard and reunites her with Poppy and Pepper; after fastening the loose latch, Miri removes the straw from the cart, folds the cloth, and checks beneath every shelf for dropped feed; Mr. Sol promises to mend the latch before sunset; Miri adds a drawing of the cozy cart nest to the care book, pleased that a moving scrap of cloth led her to the smallest hen and her unexpected hideaway'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri moves one light empty crate and peers into the fallen flowerpot; Pip is sitting inside it like a tiny brown queen, with her tail feathers pointing through the wide opening; Miri scatters corn on the floor, and Pip steps out without a scratch; together they cross the yard to the coop, where Poppy and Pepper hurry to meet her; Miri closes the loose latch with a temporary clip and asks Mr. Sol to repair it; they stand the flowerpot upright, close the shed door, and cover the low vent; in the care book, Miri draws Pip wearing a paper crown and explains how the feather by the crates revealed the royal hiding place'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Mr. Sol comes with gloves and lifts the heavy greenhouse seed tray while Miri waits beside an open carrier; Pip waddles from beneath the shelf, dusty but unharmed, and follows a few grains of corn into the carrier; Miri takes her back to Poppy and Pepper, then checks the coop latch as Mr. Sol fixes it with a new hook; together they sweep loose straw from the greenhouse floor and store it in a closed box; Miri writes that asking for help kept both Pip and the seed trays safe; when the work is done, all three hens drink fresh water while sunlight warms the repaired coop door'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri kneels beside the library bench and gently parts the dry leaves; Pip is curled in the warm hollow, sleeping with her head tucked beneath one wing; the corn bowl wakes her, and she steps calmly into Miri's waiting basket; Miri carries Pip to the coop, reunites the three hens, and fastens the loose latch with a bright clip; she leaves the remaining leaves beneath the bench for beetles and garden birds; in the holiday care book, Miri records the trail from the bent lettuce leaf to the courtyard nest; before leaving, she checks every hen once more and hears three contented clucks from the sunny coop'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri follows the fresh feather between two rows of bean plants and finds Pip tucked inside a nest of soft weeds; beside her lies a smooth speckled stone that looks almost like a tiny egg; Miri coaxes Pip into the basket with corn and carries her home to Poppy and Pepper; after securing the loose latch, she places the stone on the school nature table with a note explaining where it came from; Mr. Sol adds low netting around the bean patch so no hen can flatten the young plants; Miri finishes her care-book entry with a map of the garden trail and a careful drawing of Pip beside the egg-shaped stone'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri opens the sports box and finds Pip perched on a pile of yellow and blue bibs; Pip gives a loud cluck as if she has won a match; Miri offers corn, lifts the little hen into her basket, and carries her across the playing field; Poppy and Pepper greet Pip at the coop while Miri closes the loose latch with a clip; Mr. Sol repairs it, and Miri returns to brush straw from every bib and shut the sports box firmly; she writes the whole trail in the holiday care book and draws Pip standing on a winner podium; by lunchtime, the pavilion is tidy and all three hens are safely home'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=138 beats='Miri fetches Mr. Sol, but the wind covers the faint tracks before they return to the pavilion; they search beneath the steps, around the sports box, and along the fence without finding Pip; Miri feels disappointed, yet she remembers that Poppy and Pepper still need care; she gives them fresh water, secures the loose latch, and leaves corn beside a safe open carrier near the last feather; Mr. Sol calls two helpers and makes a careful search plan for the afternoon; Miri records every place already checked so nobody wastes time; Pip is still missing, but the school grounds are quiet, the other hens are safe, and the patient search will continue'>>
